Fantech GO W193D Dual-Mode Wireless Silent Mouse - Baby Blue (1600 DPI)

Experience the ultimate freedom of wireless productivity and silent execution with the Fantech GO W193D Dual-Mode Wireless Silent Mouse in its refreshing Baby Blue Edition. Available at Turbo Computer, this stylish and highly versatile hardware peripheral is masterfully engineered for laptop users, office professionals, and creative workspace designers across Egypt who demand flexible cross-device control and distraction-free setups. It stands as the definitive choice for a vibrant, modern, and clutter-free desktop layout configuration upgrade.

The Fantech GO W193D Baby Blue features advanced Dual-Mode wireless connectivity, allowing you to switch seamlessly between a high-speed stable 2.4GHz USB nano receiver channel and a robust Bluetooth connection layout to link with multiple devices simultaneously. Outfitted with premium silent-click switches inside a premium matte baby blue chassis, it eliminates loud distractions while preserving a tactile, responsive feel. Supporting an adjustable optical tracking resolution up to 1600 DPI, it secures smooth and stable daily hardware performance.
